say:1:1736304001:1.text: Okay, okay, stop hitting me! You just want tea, right? I'll spill everything!
say:1:1736304001:1.source_cn: 别打了！你不就是想打听消息吗！我说，我全说！
say:1:1736304001:1.male: Okay, okay, stop hitting me! You just want tea, right? I'll spill everything!
say:1:1736304001:1.female: Okay, okay, stop hitting me! You just want tea, right? I'll spill everything!

say:2:1736304002:1.text: Okay, so Lord Lumberton gets information from his people through the water routes. I'm just helping him collect it! I promise I don't know anything else!
say:2:1736304002:1.source_cn: 伦巴顿老爷一直在通过赛凡纳的水路买消息，我只是听伦巴顿...
say:2:1736304002:1.male: Okay, so Lord Lumberton gets information from his people through the water routes. I'm just helping him collect it! I promise I don't know anything else!
say:2:1736304002:1.female: Okay, so Lord Lumberton gets information from his people through the water routes. I'm just helping him collect it! I promise I don't know anything else!

say:3:1736304003:1.text: Here, take the money! Please don't rat me out!
say:3:1736304003:1.source_cn: 真的！就这些了！这钱都给你，当做封口费！
say:3:1736304003:1.male: Here, take the money! Please don't rat me out!
say:3:1736304003:1.female: Here, take the money! Please don't rat me out!

say:4:1736304004:1.text: If I get caught, I won't be able to make a living at the docks anymore!
say:4:1736304004:1.source_cn: 求求你，别把这事捅给守备军，否则我就没法在码头混了！
say:4:1736304004:1.male: If I get caught, I won't be able to make a living at the docks anymore!
say:4:1736304004:1.female: If I get caught, I won't be able to make a living at the docks anymore!
